notes.title: Update information for June 17th (2024)
notes.content:
[b] [Bug fixes] [/b]
- Fixed a bug that caused the ending movie to not play in some environments
- Fixed a situation where the poison mist screen effect remained on after clearing a boss battle
[b] [Update] [/b]
- Improved some of the effects
- Changed advice from allies during boss battles to make them easier to understand
